items.title: What Does Costco Wholesale (COST) Panic Buying Mean For Sales And Inventory?
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) reports a spike in store traffic after critical technology outages disrupted payment systems across multiple providers this week. Store managers in several major U.S. cities describe sharply higher volumes of bulk food, fuel and household essentials purchases linked to consumer panic buying.
